large_validation_diagnostics.scientific_status: descriptive validation diagnostics; not a fidelity gate and not Geant4 validation

declared_diagnostic_gap.closes_when: A diagnostics pod drains _diag/dicos-f-03/queue, which still holds all 24 checkpoints, and the metrics are imported through scripts/refresh_continuation_outputs.py.
declared_diagnostic_gap.consequence: The accepted best, dicos-f-02 epoch 90, IS measured; this gap no longer touches checkpoint selection. What remains unmeasured is the tail that failed to improve on it, so the distribution-metric trend cannot be extended past epoch 90.
declared_diagnostic_gap.reason: The RTX 3090 diagnostics pod ended between epoch 78 and 79 on 2026-08-12 while the L40S kept training to 114. A replacement 3090 replayed dicos-f-02's retained queue on 2026-08-13, closing epochs 79-90 and measuring the accepted best. The replay was stopped before dicos-f-03's queue because those epochs did not improve on epoch 90 and the owner asked for compute to stop.
